description: Seekable progress bar for media players, with optional chapters and a hover tooltip.

props.buffer: End of the buffered range, in seconds.
props.chapterGap: Width of the gap between chapters.
props.chapters: Splits the bar into chapters. Each item needs a `start`, given as seconds or formatted time (`'1:30'`, `'1:02:30'`), and can have a `title` shown in the tooltip.
props.elevation: Elevation of the thumb. Ignored with `pill` and `wavy` variants.
props.max: Duration of the media, in seconds.
props.readonly: Bar stays focusable, but does not react to pointer or keyboard.
props.step: Seconds moved by the arrow keys. Shift multiplies it by 10, or pass `[step, shiftStep]` to set both. Page Up and Page Down move by 10% of **max**.
props.thumb: Shows the thumb at the current position.
props.tooltip: Shows the time under the pointer. Accepts an object with `location` (`top` or `bottom`) and `offset`.
props.variant: `pill` follows MD3 with a bar-shaped thumb. `wavy` additionally draws the played part as a wave.

events.update:modelValue: Emitted when the position changes by clicking, dragging or keyboard.
events.drag:start: Emitted with the current position when the user starts dragging.
events.drag:end: Emitted with the final position when the user stops dragging.

slots.tooltip: Replaces the tooltip content. Receives `time` (formatted), `chapter` and `seconds`.
